# Convex

Backend-as-a-Service platform with real-time database, serverless functions, and built-in authentication

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/convex/.

## Actions

- **Create deploy key**: Create a deploy key for use with the Convex CLI.
- **Create Deployment**: Create a new deployment for a Convex project.
- **Create Project**: Create a new project on a Convex team, optionally provisioning a dev or prod deployment.
- **Delete Deployment**: Delete a Convex deployment.
- **Get Deployment Details** (read-only): Retrieve details about a Convex cloud deployment.
- **Get Project by ID** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a specific Convex project by its ID.
- **Get Project by Slug** (read-only): Retrieve a Convex project by its slug within a team.
- **Get token details** (read-only): Retrieve token details for the authenticated token.
- **List Deploy Keys** (read-only): List all deploy keys for a specified Convex deployment.
- **List Deployments** (read-only): List all deployments for a Convex project.
- **List Log Streams** (read-only): List all existing log stream configurations in a deployment.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List all projects for a specific Convex team.
- **Update Deployment**: Update properties of an existing Convex deployment.
- **Delete Custom Domain**: Remove a custom domain from a Convex deployment.
- **Delete project**: Deletes a Convex project and all its deployments permanently.
- **Execute Query Batch** (read-only): Execute multiple Convex query functions in a single batch request.
- **Get Query Timestamp** (read-only): Get the latest timestamp for queries from Convex deployment.
- **List deployment classes** (read-only): List available deployment classes for a Convex team.
- **List deployment regions** (read-only): List available deployment regions for a Convex team.
